evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese Lexical Database), CUHK
evidence.field: 形義通解／甲金文字形與用例
evidence.text: The entry displays oracle-bone, bronze, and small-seal forms, and analyzes the early graph as 女 semantic + 未 phonetic. It reads many oracle-bone uses as 昧, ‘before dawn’; bronze uses include ‘younger sister’ and a loan use for 昧. It cites the Song gong Luan gui for the kinship sense and Da Yu ding for 妹辰, interpreted as 昧爽. These are the database’s readings, not a settled chronology of the spoken senses.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 妹

evidence.source: Institute of History and Philology, Academia Sinica
evidence.field: Article abstract: 論殷墟甲骨文的否定詞「妹」
evidence.text: The abstract summarizes earlier oracle-bone interpretations of 妹 as a place name or as dawn, then argues the dawn reading is untenable, that only a minority of cases may be a place name, and that most cases should be read as a negative word close in sound and meaning to 蔑. The abstract is accessible, but the full argument was not assessed here.
evidence.title: 論殷墟甲骨文的否定詞「妹」 — Bulletin of the Institute of History and Philology, Academia Sinica

evidence.field: 大盂鼎銘文／transcription and dating note
evidence.text: The page labels the inscription early Western Zhou and says the vessel was cast in King Kang’s 23rd year. Its transcription includes 女妹辰; the edited text reads this 汝昧辰. That supports the existence of the debated phrase and an editorial reading as 昧, but does not settle whether it means dawn or childhood.
evidence.title: 大盂鼎銘文 — 維基文庫

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.text: Records the Shuowen analysis 女弟也、从女未聲, fanqie 莫佩切, and modern Mandarin mèi. It lists younger sister, a younger female relative of the same generation, a woman’s modest self-reference, and young woman, with literary examples. Those examples attest uses but do not establish their chronology or semantic paths.
evidence.title: A00902 妹 — 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.text: For 女, the page gives modern Beijing Mandarin nǚ, Middle Chinese nrjoX, Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese *nraʔ, and Zhengzhang *naʔ. These are readings for 女, not evidence for its semantic role in 妹.

gaps: The 1995 Academia Sinica article’s abstract challenges the CUHK dawn interpretation and proposes a negative reading related to 蔑; the full article’s evidence was not inspected, so this disagreement remains unresolved.
CUHK cites the Song gong Luan gui for a bronze kinship use, but this pass did not independently inspect an artifact catalogue or verify the vessel’s date.
The sources attest kinship, young-woman, broader younger-relative, and modest self-reference senses, but do not demonstrate a chronological semantic path among them.

The proposed oracle-bone dawn use and the possible loan spelling of 昧 remain disputed. No independently established source-word pronunciation or semantic relationship between dawn-related uses and the kinship word was found.
Official Unicode Unihan pages for 妹, 未, and 女 all returned access errors. Provided local kMandarin rows are preserved as local metadata, not represented as externally verified Unicode records.
The provided Baxter–Sagart table contains exact rows for 妹, 未, and 女. The inspected external page gives 妹 and 女 readings; the exact external 未 row was not independently verified in this pass.
The Xiaoxuetang evolution page loaded as a query page but yielded no textually readable form sequence; the form labels and dates could not be confirmed from its extracted contents.
Commons verifies a public-domain modern redraw labeled Shuowen seal style; no physical inscription image was visually inspected, and no artifact provenance or dating can be assigned to the redraw.

No evidence establishes that the 未 element in 妹 developed through graphic corruption from 末. Duan Yucai’s reported 末-associated explanation in the dossier remains historical commentary rather than demonstrated graphic ancestry.
The imported Sino-Tibetan comparisons were outside this bounded search and are not evaluated here.
